raw_segments.text: Well, what then? Ilya Petrovich drawled with gentlemanly nonchalance, and he walked with
some papers to another table, with a jaunty swing of his shoulders at each step.
Here, if you will kindly look, an author or a student has been one at least, does not
pay his debts, has given an I.O.U., won't clear out of his room, and complaints are
constantly being lodged against him, and here he has been pleased to make a protest against
He behaves like a cat himself, and just look at him, please.
Here's the gentleman, and very attractive he is.
